description: TF-IDF full-text search over the archived news headlines + the pulse-fact corpus (a lexical index, not embeddings). Returns {query, count, results, index}; each result is {type ('news' | 'fact'), text, score (0-1 cosine), metadata}. `limit` default 20, hard cap 50. The first call after a restart pays the index build (seconds); later calls are fast. RESTRICTED posture: a keyed tool (refuses anonymous callers). For per-ticker archive reads use get_news; for semantic retrieval over SEC filings use ol_filing_search. Caveats ride the response's tool_notes. Needs an Oxford Ledge API key that the client's operator configures; anonymous callers are refused.
name: search_news_archive
title: News Archive Search
